title: Calculate age in years
statement_markdown: Write a query to find information based on members(id, name, birth_year).
hints: Review the problem statement and expected output.
reference_solution: SELECT name, (2026 - birth_year) AS age FROM members ORDER BY age DESC

validation.setup_sql: CREATE TABLE members (id INT, name VARCHAR(50), birth_year INT); INSERT INTO members VALUES (1, 'Alice', 1990), (2, 'Bob', 2000), (3, 'Charlie', 1985), (4, 'David', 2010);
